note: Recorded 2026-11-19 by a hand-run probe through @mcp-abap-adt/connection (the research for the table settings contract, interfaces-adt 28.0.0); the probe logged the status, the content type, the ETag where shown and the body, and nothing else. The user id is replaced by SAPUSER01. S/4HANA 2025 on premise, a fresh table in $TMP under the settings lock: a PUT whose document has no adtcore:description is refused (SWB_TOOL 019). The response headers were not logged.

request.headersNote: Caller-supplied headers only. The lock handle is not recorded; the connection adds the logon and the session below this point, none of which is recorded.
request.bodyNote: Not the logged body: the probe did not log request bodies. This is the minimal document the research notes give for this step — it carried no adtcore:description attribute at all, and that is what SAP refused. The library cannot send such a document (the contract requires a description); its unit test sends an empty one and passes this answer on.
